data.name: Wandslinger
data.detailed_description:
The resources for magic are being hoarded by the powerful, and all known deposits have long run dry. Play as an explorer who is searching for any remaining sources of magic crystals, and complete repeated runs in this rogue-lite spellbuilder to try and secure a new supply of magic for the common people.

BUILD YOUR OWN BULLET HELL

Magic is not something to take lightly, yet you will need enough fire-power to clear out all the hostile remnants from the old world. Strike a balance between building larger chain-reactions and leaving yourself enough space to avoid them all, as all magic has the potential to bite.

SHARED DREAMS

Everyday you will attempt to secure the supply in a new way, and everyday you will return to camp where other like-minded explorers have settled. See how other individuals approach creating magics, and help them overcome their own fears that prevent them from committing fully to chasing their dreams.

BURNING OUT THE WORLD

Uncover the mysteries of why magic crystals have become such a scarce resource, discover the truths of the depravity of an enemy that can not be beaten. Find your own answer for how to handle the fact that something is always in the way of your dreams.

A PREMORTEM STYLE FOR THOSE ALIVE

Art is made for the living, and PreMortem aims to create vivid, handcrafted pieces of fun adventure with underlying depth and emotion inspired by real life struggles.

data.short_description: Chase the highs of creating the best chain-reactions of magic and then evade the bullet hell you create when trying to reach the depths of the world in this rogue-lite spellbuilder.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 950, Radeon R7 360, or Intel HD Graphics 630
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060, Radeon RX 5600 XT, or Intel Arc A580
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The game will feature fantasy violence, have world building of a troublesome past, and follow storylines of people fighting against depression, and not always winning.
